questions.q_en: A vendor marks the price of tea 40% above the cost price and gives a 12% discount. He also uses a faulty scale, giving only 850 gm instead of 1 kg. Find his total percentage profit.
questions.solution_en:
Let cost price of 1000 gm of tea = ₹100

Marked price of tea = 140% of 100 = ₹140

Discount = 12%

Selling price of tea = (100 - 12)% of 140 = ₹123.2

Cost price of 850 gm = ₹85

Profit percentage = [(123.2 - 85)/85]*100 = 44.94%

3A - A = 12

2A = 12

A = 6

So, Y = 18 and X = 6

Therefore,

X + 3Y = 6 + 54 = 60

questions.q_en: A car travels the first 160 km at a speed of 64 km/h and the next 160 km at a speed of 80 km/hr What is the average speed for the first 320 km of the tour?

Total distance covered = 160 + 160 = 320 km

Total time taken = 160/64 + 160/80 = 2.5 + 2 = 4.5 hours

Average speed = Total distance covered/Total time taken = 320/4.5

= 71.11 km/h

questions.q_en: The lateral surface area of a rectangular block is 4046 sq. cm. If length, breadth, and height are in the ratio of 5: 2: 1, find length.
questions.solution_en:
Let the length, breadth, and height of the block be 5X cm, 2X cm, and X cm respectively.

Lateral surface area = 4046

2 * X * (5X + 2X) = 4046

14X2 = 4046

X2 = 289

X = 17 cm

Length = 5X = 17 * 5 = 85 cm

P can do a certain work in 36 days and Q and R together can do the same work in 20 days. If Q can do the same work in 2.5 times the number of days in which P and R together can do, find the number of days taken by R alone to complete the same work.
questions.solution_en:
Let total work = LCM of 36 and 20 = 180 units

Efficiency of P = 180/36 = 5 units per day

Efficiency of Q and R = 180/20 = 9 units per day

Efficiency of P, Q, and R together = 14 units per day

Ratio of number of days taken by Q and (P + R) = 2.5: 1 = 5: 2

Ratio of efficiencies of Q and (P + R) = 2: 5

So,

Q + P + R = 14

7x = 14

x = 2

Efficiency of P + R = 5x = 10

Efficiency of R = 10 - 5 = 5 units per day

Required answer = 180/5 = 36 days

questions.q_en: Pipe A fills a tank in 6 hours, pipe B in 3 hours, and pipe C empties it in 6 hours. A is open for 2 hours, then B for 2 hours, then C for 2 hours, and finally all three are opened together until the tank is full. Find the total time taken in this process to fill the tank.
questions.solution_en:
Let, total work = 1 full tank

Rate of pipe A = 1/6 tank per hour

Rate of pipe B = 1/3 tank per hour

Rate of pipe C = - 1/6 tank per hour

Work done in first 2 h by pipe A = 2 X (1/6) = 1/3

Work done in next 2 h by pipe B = 2 X (1/3) = 2/3

Work done in next 2 h by pipe C = 2 X ( - 1/6) = - 1/3

Net work after first 6 h = 1/3 + 2/3 - 1/3 = 2/3

Remaining work = 1 - 2/3 = 1/3

Combined rate of pipes A, B & C = 1/6 + 1/3 - 1/6 = 1/3 tank per hour

Time to finish = (1/3) / (1/3) = 1 hour

Total time = 6 h + 1 h = 7 hours

questions.q_en: A motorboat covers 56 km upstream in 4 hours and the same distance downstream in 2 hours. What are its speed in still water and the stream's speed?
questions.solution_en:
Let, speed of boat in still water and speed of stream be b km/h and s km/h respectively.

Upstream speed = 56/4 = 14 km/h

Downstream speed = 56/2 = 28 km/h

b - s = 14, b + s = 28 => 2b = 42 => b = 21; s = 7

Find the values of x, y and z, so as to satisfy the equations given below:

x + y + z = 18, x + y - z = 4, x - y + z = 8
questions.solution_en:
x + y + z = 18, x + y - z = 4, x - y + z = 8

Only option 'b' satisfies the equation x + y + z = 18. i.e.

6 + 5 + 7 = 18

x + y - z = 4 => 6 + 5 - 7 = 4

x - y + z = 6 - 5 + 7 = 8

Hence, option 'b' is correct.
